title: VAT Rates
permissionNote: Only administrators can modify VAT rates. You can still review the catalog.

essential.title: Name the tax and enter its percentage
essential.description: Use a clear name and the exact percentage, such as VAT 19% or VAT 5%.

advanced.title: Availability
advanced.description: Mark whether this rate is currently in use.

unsavedChanges.title: Discard VAT rate changes?
unsavedChanges.status: VAT rate changes have not been saved

fields.name: VAT rate name
fields.isActiveHelp: Turn this off to mark the rate as no longer in use. Previous records are not removed.

delete.title: Delete VAT Rate
delete.description: Delete this VAT rate? Products that use it must be assigned another rate first.
